name: s4-fabric-interview-question
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Here's a Microsoft Fabric interview question that trips up Power BI people.
lines.sub: that trips up Power BI people

lines.say: Your sales data lives in a lakehouse, as Delta tables in OneLake.
lines.show: Sales data: *Delta tables* in a lakehouse, in OneLake.

lines.say: The report needs import speed, but nobody wants to wait for an import refresh.
Which storage mode? A, Import. B, DirectQuery. C, Direct Lake. D, Dual.
Pause, and lock in your answer.
Power BI loads the Delta columns straight from OneLake, and a refresh only copies metadata, in a few seconds.
Now the answer that gets you the job: there are two kinds of Direct Lake.
Direct Lake on SQL falls back to DirectQuery when the SQL endpoint has row-level security, and can get slower.
lines.show: On SQL: row-level security → *falls back* to DirectQuery.

lines.say: Direct Lake on OneLake never falls back, but it doesn't apply that SQL security either.
lines.show: On OneLake: *never falls back*, and skips that SQL security.

lines.say: Comment the answer you picked before the reveal.
